summary: Validated the is_sunday_blocked(meal_date, meal_type) fix end-to-end. Backend: 14 pytest cases pass, 1 skipped (only relevant when tomorrow is Sunday). Employee login (612480/newpass123) works, /api/bookings/status now returns HTTP 200 with new fields day_label + sunday_off (bool) + cancellation (nullable). Frontend: Employee dashboard passes 'Loading your dashboard…' and renders both meal-card-breakfast and meal-card-dinner (Booked/Open badges visible) with zero /api/ errors captured. Admin edit-employee dialog exposes the 'Reset password (optional)' field with data-testid=edit-employee-password-input; admin password reset round-trip verified (612480 -> tmp -> back to newpass123). Sunday overrides CRUD (POST/GET/DELETE) works and stores meals='breakfast'|'dinner'|'both' correctly. Non-Sunday dates are never Sunday-blocked. Brand is 'SUPER MILER' on login, employee dashboard and admin console; no 'SUPER MILLER' or 'Baratie' strings anywhere.

ui_bugs.issue: Reset-password input renders with type='text' instead of type='password'; the new password is visible on screen when admin types it. Should be a masked input (or PasswordInput with visibility toggle) for basic shoulder-surfing protection.

action_items: Consider changing edit-employee-password-input from type='text' to type='password' (or use the existing PasswordInput component) so the reset password isn't shown in cleartext.
critical_code_review_comments: is_sunday_blocked(meal_date, meal_type) implementation in server.py is correct: returns True on Sunday when no override, or when the override's meals field doesn't cover the requested meal_type ('breakfast'|'dinner') and isn't 'both'. Type signature matches the caller in booking_status (server.py:431) and create_booking (server.py:482).

In create_booking, opens_at check runs before is_sunday_blocked; this is fine but means booking attempts for Sundays outside the booking window return an 'opens at' error rather than a Sunday-off error. Not a bug, but noted for future UX polish if you want a Sunday-specific message earlier.

server.py is 2139 lines and mixes helpers, routes, admin, and payroll logic. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, bookings.py, admin.py, payroll.py) for maintainability — file-size guideline of ~700 lines is exceeded.
AdminDashboard.jsx (~1380 lines) has grown large; splitting per tab (Bookings, Employees, Emergency, Holidays, Menu, Audit) into sub-components would help maintainability and test isolation.
test_credentials: Admin 135791/admin@123, Employee 612480/newpass123 (restored to original after password-rotation regression test).
seed_data_creation: None persistent. All sunday_overrides created during tests are deleted at the end of the same test. TEST_ prefixed employees left over from prior iterations still exist in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login field data-testid is 'login-employee-input' (not 'login-employee-number-input'). Auth response returns 'token' (not 'access_token'). Payroll export expects month=YYYY-MM (single param). Prices endpoint for admin PUT is /api/admin/settings/prices (public GET at /api/settings/prices). The per-meal Sunday POST /bookings test cannot actually exercise the Sunday-block branch unless today is Saturday/Sunday because opens_at check runs first — so we verify override storage roundtrip + a conditional booking_status.sunday_off flip when tomorrow is Sunday.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was a reverted 1-arg signature of is_sunday_blocked while the caller in booking_status passed 2 args (meal_date, meal_type), which raised TypeError inside GET /api/bookings/status -> HTTP 500 -> EmployeeDashboard stuck at 'Loading your dashboard…'. Fix (already applied by main agent) reintroduced the (meal_date, meal_type) signature and per-meal override check against sunday_overrides.meals ∈ {breakfast, dinner, both}. Verified via pytest (bookings/status now 200 with day_label/sunday_off/cancellation) and browser (dashboard renders both meal cards).
